rows.pred:
SELECT c.name, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales
FROM companyx.clients c
JOIN companyx.sales s ON c.id = s.client_id
WHERE c.region = '서울'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales
FROM companyx.sales s
WHERE s.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-06-30'

SELECT AVG(s.amount) AS avg_monthly_sales
FROM companyx.sales s
JOIN companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.category = '보안 솔루션'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.contracts WHERE status = 'active'

SELECT e.id, e.name, e.email, e.salary
FROM companyx.employees e
JOIN companyx.departments d ON e.dept_id = d.id
WHERE d.name = '기술지원팀'

SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(p.id) AS project_count
FROM companyx.clients c
JOIN companyx.contracts co ON c.id = co.client_id
JOIN companyx.projects p ON co.id = p.contract_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY project_count DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM companyx.support_tickets WHERE priority = 'Critical' AND status != 'Resolved'

SELECT companyx.products.name, SUM(companyx.contracts.amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM companyx.products
JOIN companyx.contracts ON companyx.products.id = companyx.contracts.product_id
GROUP BY companyx.products.name
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.clients WHERE registered_at >= '2024-01-01' AND registered_at < '2025-01-01'

SELECT d.name, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary
FROM companyx.departments d
JOIN companyx.employees e ON d.id = e.dept_id
GROUP BY d.name
ORDER BY avg_salary DESC
LIMIT 1
